CLOSING TASK (the 6 llm-review findings blocking PR #631's review-sub-pr; folded here from the resilience-hardening story per panel topology -- land on the EXISTING #631 branch to complete this story). Fix plugins/dso/scripts/ci/check-dangling-references.sh + harnesses. DEFAULT to FAIL-CLOSED: a "skip the symbol" branch is itself a false-negative path, so skip only with a logged reason, else INDETERMINATE/error. (Line refs approximate -- file shifted since #631; resolve each PR #631 review comment when addressed.)
1. _materialize_head_file (~:143-151): the git-show exit-code skip is ALREADY present (candidates come from `git grep -lw $sym $HEAD`, so the file exists at HEAD) -- HARDEN the `>` redirect ordering AND add the missing exit-code check on the sg invocation at ~:172 (`run -p ... 2>/dev/null` currently swallows parse failures -> silent empty -> false negative).
2. _defined_at_head shell-def regex (~:128) + def-exclusion filters (~:175 sg, ~:182 grep): require `{` after `()` so `${sym}()` stops matching real Python 0-arg calls (false negatives); keep the Python def/class exclusion.
3. _doc_references (~:189): the live tree ALREADY has -w (`git grep -nwF`) -- verify against the PR-631 baseline; if present, this finding is MOOT (no change).
4. DSO_DANGLING_MIN_LEN (~:53 + use ~:198): validate numeric before bash arithmetic (reject non-numeric env input).
5. sg detection (~:67): align with centrality.sh:18-26's stricter `sg --version | grep -qE '^(sg|ast-grep) [0-9]'`.
6. Harnesses (test-dangling-references-sg-matcher.sh, tests/scripts/measure-dangling-fp-fn.sh): isolate the git env (HOME/GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL); check git-op exit codes in _build_repo. RED tests reproduce the regex false-negative AND the sg-invocation silent-empty before the fix (GREEN after).
